newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Burns Philp shares see high volume.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Burns Philp shares see high volume.

text.p: Troubled food group Burns Philp and Co saw 8.18 million shares or over 1.5 percent of its capital traded in the morning session on Thursday.
The bulk of the trade was in one line of 8.0 million shares, specialled through First Pacific Stockbroking at a price of A$1.70 per share.
By 11.55 a.m. (0155 GMT), Burns Philp shares were one cent lower at A$1.79 on total turnover of 8.18 million shares.
Brokers said an institutional investor appeared to have exited the stock following their recent full year results.
Burns Philp reported a net loss of A$61.8 million for the full year to June 30, failed to declare a dividend and saw its shares dip to a 10 year low of A$1.75 on September 6.
A spokesman for Burns Philp said the company was as yet unaware of the parties to the transaction.
"We are not aware of the identity of the parties as yet and I am not prepared to speculate as to who it may be," he said.
By 3.00 p.m. (0500 GMT), Burns Philp shares were four cents lower at A$1.76 on turnover of 8.4 million shares.
